body.name: \(R_{\mathrm{ad}}(\gamma)\)
body.construction: Whenever \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\ne\varnothing\), for every nonempty \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)\) define \(R_{\mathrm{ad}}(\gamma)=\inf_{\mathcal C\in\mathfrak H_0}\sup_{\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(\gamma)}\mathbb E_\vartheta[\operatorname{diam}_2\{\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1)\}]\).
